summary: KKR & Co. Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. On July 30, 2026, subsidiaries KKR Group Partnership L.P. and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. L.P. entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement providing a $3.0 billion senior unsecured multicurrency revolving credit facility, with an option to increase by $750 million. The facility matures July 30, 2031, with interest based on SOFR or alternate base rate plus a ratings-based margin of 57.5–112.5 bps. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
